title: The Wildest Olympic Marathon Ever 🏃
caption:
The Olympic marathon "winner" rode in a car 🏃🚗
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. At the 1904 St. Louis Olympics, Fred Lorz crossed the line first after riding in a car for about ten miles and was disqualified. The real winner, Thomas Hicks, was given strychnine and brandy by his trainers. Another runner napped after eating rotten apples and still finished fourth.
Which runner was the real legend? 👇
first_comment: Car guy, rat-poison guy or the apple-nap guy. Who's your champion? 🏃👇
